full_prompt_en: A square wall-painting illustration shows a young woman sitting with knees drawn up against a weathered turquoise and ochre surface. She occupies the left and lower center, turned in profile toward the right. One elbow rests on a raised knee, and her hand lies across her forehead as if shielding her eyes or gathering thought. Dark teal hair is loosely tied back, with strands escaping around her cheek; a small gold goggle-like band or round accent rests at the crown. She wears a warm ochre shirt with rolled sleeves and dark green trousers, with black boots angled across the lower edge. The opposite arm crosses in front of her bent legs, keeping the pose compact. Behind her, the wall is a patchwork of turquoise, faded blue, warm gray, and exposed beige plaster. Sketchy spirals and pale abstract marks appear to the right, but no detailed environment is established. The ledge beneath her is a rough horizontal block, its front face stained and scraped in brown and cream. The figure is built from energetic dark contour lines and broken color hatching, with face and hands given more precise modeling than clothing or wall. Light comes softly from the upper left, warming the skin and yellow shirt while cooler shadow sits under the knees and around the hair. The surface visibly carries scratches, paint wear, and masonry grain, so the illustration feels physically attached to an old wall. The camera looks straight at the artwork, keeping its shallow illustrated space distinct from the real texture of the carrier. No readable text appears in the selected image. The overall composition is contemplative and urban, using a folded pose and warm-cool surface contrast to hold attention within an open, distressed field.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形墙绘插画呈现一名年轻女子抱膝坐在受风化的青绿与赭色表面前。她占据左侧与下方中央，侧身朝右。一只手肘落在抬起的膝盖上，手掌横搭额头，仿佛遮住目光或凝神思索。深青色头发松松扎在脑后，几缕散在脸旁；头顶有一道小金色护目镜状带或圆形装饰。她穿暖赭色卷袖衬衫和深绿长裤，黑靴斜置于下缘。另一只手臂横过弯曲双腿前方，使姿势紧凑。身后墙面由青绿、褪蓝、暖灰与露出的米色灰泥拼成。右边有草草画出的旋线与浅色抽象痕迹，但没有具体环境。身下台沿是一块粗糙水平体，正面被棕与奶油白污迹、刮痕覆盖。人物由有力的深轮廓线和破碎色彩排线构成，脸与手的塑形比衣服或墙面更精确。光从左上柔和照来，温暖皮肤与黄衬衫，较冷阴影落在膝下及发间。表面明显承载刮痕、颜料磨损和砖石颗粒，使插画像真实附着在旧墙上。相机正对作品，浅层插画空间与载体实体肌理各自清楚。所选图里没有可读文字。整体构图沉思且有城市感，以收拢的姿势和表面冷暖对比在开放、破损的色域里维持注意。
style_prompt_en: The wall-painting style combines agile dark sketch lines with broken washes of teal, blue, ochre, and exposed warm plaster. The substrate is active: scratches, stains, grain, and faded edges join the drawing rather than sit behind a polished image. A compact, more clearly modeled focal form sits within looser abstract marks and open distressed space. Crosshatched contours give limbs or folds weight, while larger color areas remain patchy and translucent. Warm light accents lift selected planes against cool surrounding tones; shadows stay integrated into the textured surface. Horizontal support lines counter restless curves and scribbles. The overall effect is reflective and handmade, with urban material wear lending depth to an otherwise shallow graphic composition.
style_prompt_zh: 这种墙绘风格把迅疾的深色速写线与青绿、蓝、赭色和露出的暖灰泥破碎水洗结合。载体积极参与：刮痕、污迹、颗粒和褪色边缘加入图像，而非仅藏在抛光画面后。紧凑、塑形较清楚的焦点形体置于更松散的抽象痕迹和开放破损空间中。交叉排线轮廓给予肢体或衣褶重量，较大色域保持斑驳半透明。暖光重音在周围冷调前提亮局部平面；阴影仍与肌理表面相融。水平支撑线对照躁动曲线与涂鸦。整体效果沉思且手工感鲜明，城市材料磨损为原本较浅的图形构图增加纵深。
theme_en: A pensive seated young woman in a textured teal-and-ochre wall painting
theme_zh: 一名沉思的年轻女子坐在青绿与赭色的肌理墙画里
name: Alice Pasquini
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
